attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 7 Ιουνίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. **There is an open identity question here and it is left open.** The corpus keeps `martha-sister-of-lykarion` and `mary-sister-of-lykarion` on 8 February, in both the Romanian and the Greek calendars, and their life says their brother was the child martyr Lykarion; the corpus keeps no folder for that brother. saint.gr's man on 7 June is from Hermoupolis in Egypt and is given a long series of tortures with no mention of sisters and no mention of his being a child, and the 8 February pair's page is a different page on a different day. Since nothing read here makes the two one man, this folder is made for the man saint.gr keeps on 7 June alone, no `related` row to the two sisters is written, and the question is named in the report. The page gives no year and no emperor, so there is no `dates` object, and it prints no hymn.
